details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1 (headline financial performance), K2 (order book), K3 (segment performance), K4 (major project developments), K5 (real estate activity), K7 (profitability metrics), and K8 (liquidity position). However, it omits the market outlook details in K6, the dividend payment information in K9, and the post-reporting-period event in K10. These omissions are material for K6 (MEDIUM importance) and K9 (MEDIUM importance), and K10 (MEDIUM importance), resulting in a mixed coverage where most key information is present but several important elements are missing.

coherence_issues.description: Sentence S19 contains a self-contradiction in the comparison date for cash and cash equivalents. It states 'compared to EUR 25.9 million at the end of June 2026,' which is logically impossible as it attempts to compare the same period (end of June 2026) to itself. The comparison should reference the prior year period (end of June 2025).

details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is generally coherent with logical relationships between revenue, profitability metrics, segment performance, and balance sheet items. Explanations flow naturally from consolidated figures to segment breakdowns and order book developments. The only material issue is the self-contradiction in S19 where the comparison date for cash and cash equivalents is incorrectly stated as the same period being compared to itself. This is an internal logical error independent of external data validation. All other sentences maintain internal consistency and logical progression.
